name: Dule BookDrop
description: Send ebooks to Kobo, Kindle, or Tolino ereaders easily through their built-in browser.

CONVERTER_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Converter timeout in ms. Keep under 30000 to stay within Heroku's 30s HTTP router timeout.

KINDLING_MEMORY_LIMIT_BYTES.description: Address-space limit in bytes for kindling-cli (set to 268435456 on 512 MB dynos, or 402653184 on 1 GB+ dynos).

BALKANDOWNLOAD_ENABLED.description: Set to 0 to disable BalkanDownload.org search and background SQLite catalog sync.

GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY.description: Optional Google Books API key for EPUB metadata enrichment.
